question: Who among the following took charge as Vice Chief of Army Staff in February 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandi Prasad Mohanty.**__

__
 
• Lieutenant General Chandi Prasad Mohanty has taken over as the Vice Chief of the Army Staff.

 
 
• Lt Gen CP Mohanty was commissioned into the Rajput Regiment in 1982.__
 
• An alumnus of Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC) Dehradun and National Defence Academy, Lt Gen Mohanty is a June 1982 batch Infantry Officer from the Rajput Regiment.
